title: Tigers can swim across 8 km of water
caption:
Tigers can swim across rivers and lakes up to 8 km wide.

No two tigers share the same stripe pattern, so researchers use stripes like fingerprints to identify wild individuals.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo & Conservation Biology Institute. Swimming footage: a captive tiger at Tiger Park Pattaya. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
